messages.content: How would you respond to the following statement: On the whole, I am satisfied with myself.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: At times I think I am no good at all.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I feel that I have a number of good qualities.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I am able to do things as well as most other people.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I feel I do not have much to be proud of.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I certainly feel useless at times.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I feel that I am a person of worth, at least on an equal plane with others.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I wish I could have more respect for myself.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I take a positive attitude toward myself.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Deep down, I am inadequate.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: If people really knew me, they would reject me.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I am fundamentally more flawed than other people.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: My worth as a person depends on succeeding at everything I do.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: One serious mistake is enough to show that I am a failure.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I am a worthwhile person even when I fail at something.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I deserve care and respect just like anyone else.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Making mistakes does not make me less of a person.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: People generally like me once they get to know me.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I can handle difficult situations as well as most people.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
